title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash requests reroute to Omni 1.2 Flash and bill at its rates from December 3, 2026
detail: The Gemini API release notes for November 5, 2026 state that effective December 3, 2026, API requests to gemini-omni-1.1-flash will automatically route to gemini-omni-1.2-flash at Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash rates. The same entry releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash as generally available with 30% lower video output pricing, listed at $12.00 per 1M tokens, and doubled paid-tier rate limits.
impact: Video generation code still calling gemini-omni-1.1-flash keeps working after December 3 but runs on a different model. Google lists the new model's video output price as 30% lower and its paid-tier rate limits as doubled. Output can differ between versions, so switch the model string and test before December 3.
